products.name: ANA ABIYEDH
products.description:
Lattafa Ana Abiyedh (often referred to as "I Am White") is a popular, highly affordable unisex Eau de Parfum celebrated for its fresh, clean, and creamy profile. It is widely loved as an accessible and versatile everyday signature scent, Vibe: Uplifting, soft, and lightly sweet without being overpowering. Unisex (though leaning slightly feminine to some due to the vanilla and pear, it works beautifully on anyone). 
Performance: Excellent longevity and sillage, typically lingering well throughout the day.

products.name: Lattafa Asad Bourbon
products.description: Lattafa Asad Bourbon (2025) is a bold, warm, and spicy perfume for men, designed for confident presence and long-lasting wear. It features a, rich, sweet, and smoky profile with notes of pink pepper, cacao, bourbon vanilla, and amber. The scent is described as a sophisticated, luxurious, and intense fragrance, often noted for its resemblance to Azzaro's The Most Wanted line.

products.name: Asad
products.description: Lattafa Asad is a rich, warm, and spicy amber fragrance for men, widely celebrated as an excellent alternative to Dior Sauvage Elixir. It balances bold, smoky notes with a smooth, sweet vanilla finish, making it perfect for the evening or cooler months.

products.name: ANGHAM for women
products.description: Lattafa Angham is a 2024 unisex Oriental Vanilla fragrance featuring a warm, creamy, and gently spiced blend of lavender, praline, cacao, and vanilla. Known for its high affordability and long-lasting 8+ hour performance, it is widely considered an alluring alternative to Burberry Goddess.

products.name: AJAYEB DUBAI POTRAIT
products.description: Ajayeb Dubai Portrait by Lattafa is a vibrant, unisex fragrance released in 2023 that beautifully blends exotic tropical fruits with warm oriental woods. It features bright top notes of orange and lemon, a juicy mango and floral heart, and a luxurious base of oud, musk, and amber.

products.name: AJWAD
products.description: Lattafa Ajwad is a popular, richly layered unisex fragrance that perfectly balances fruity sweetness, soft florals, and warm, sensual woods.

products.name: AJAYEB DUBAI
products.description: Lattafa Ajayeb Dubai is a luxurious, unisex Eau de Parfum from the UAE, famed for its rich, long-lasting aroma. It comes in two popular variants: Ajayeb Dubai (Black), a warm, sweet gourmand with notes of coffee, pineapple, and butterscotch, and Ajayeb Dubai Portrait, a tropical, fruity blend of mango, citrus, and oud.

products.name: BADAE AL OUD - OUD FOR GLORY
products.description: Bade'e Al Oud - Oud for Glory by Lattafa is a highly acclaimed unisex amber woody fragrance launched in 2020. It is most widely and commercially available in a 100 ml (3.4 oz) Eau de Parfum (EDP) bottle.

products.name: AL NASHAMA CAPRICE
products.description: Lattafa Al Nashama Caprice is an aromatic, spicy fragrance for both men and women. It opens with an energetic blast of fresh cardamom and ginger, which mellows into a clean, floral-herbal core of lavender and mint. The dry-down settles into a warm, woody-amber base.Known for being a highly affordable alternative to YSL La Nuit de l'Homme Bleu Électrique, this versatile scent is perfect for daily office wear, casual outings, or evening events.

products.name: BADAE AL OUD - HONOR & GLORY
products.description:
Lattafa Bade'e Al Oud - Honor & Glory is an opulent, unisex oriental fragrance launched in 2023. It is widely produced and sold as a standard 100 ml (3.4 fl oz) Eau de Parfum (EDP) bottle.
Top Notes: Pineapple Brûlée and Crème Brûlée.
Heart Notes: Turmeric, Cinnamon, Black Pepper, and Benzoin.
Base Notes: Vanilla, Cashmeran, Sandalwood, and Moss.

products.name: BADAE AL OUD - Amethyst
products.description:
Badee Al Oud - Amethyst is a luxurious unisex amber vanilla fragrance by Lattafa Perfumes, launched in 2021. It is offered in a single.
Net Quantity: 100ml (Eau de Parfum)
Scent Profile: Opens with fresh pink pepper and bergamot, leading to a rich floral heart of Bulgarian and Turkish roses, and finishing on a warm base of oud, amber, and vanilla.

products.name: BADAE AL OUD - Noble Blush
products.description: Lattafa Bade'e Al Oud - Noble Blush is an ultra-feminine, floral-fruity-gourmand fragrance that blends rose milk with creamy meringue, almond, and warm vanilla.

products.name: Alpine homme sport
products.description: Alpine Homme Sport by Maison Alhambra is an invigorating, fresh, and woody-spicy Eau de Parfum (EDP) for men. Widely known as an affordable, high-quality clone of Chanel's iconic Allure Homme Sport, it offers an energetic blend of zesty citruses, cooling mint, and sensual woods

products.name: Al Mukhtalif Signature
products.description: Nusuk Al Mukhtalif Signature Extrait de Parfum is a bold, woody-aromatic fragrance for men. It offers incredible intensity, featuring a zesty and spicy opening that melts into a deep, smoky heart, and settles into an opulent, long-lasting base of musk, vanilla, and amber.

products.name: AZURE VELVET Extrait De Parfum
products.description:
Azure Velvet Extrait De Parfum by Khadlaj Perfumes is a unisex citrus-aromatic fragrance. It is widely celebrated as an affordable, mass-appealing alternative to designer scents like Parfums de Marly Layton.
Launch Date : Originally released in 2025. Quantity: Available in standard 100 ml (3.4 oz) flacons.
Quick Scent Profile : Top Notes: Bergamot, Lavender, Mint.
Heart Notes: Floral and fruity accords.
Base Notes: Woody notes, powdery accords, and incense.

products.name: ISLAND VANILLA DUNES Extrait De Parfum
Amber Musc EDP
products.description: Ajmal Amber Musc EDP is a luxurious, gender-neutral fragrance that masterfully balances delicate floral notes with rich, warm, and woody undertones. Known for its elegant, creamy, and long-lasting trail, it is a versatile signature scent perfect for both everyday wear and intimate evening outings.

products.name: Amber Wood EDP
products.description: Ajmal Amber Wood EDP is a luxurious, unisex Oriental Woody fragrance launched in 2014. Known for its rich, long-lasting performance, it offers a captivating blend of warmth, spice, and deep woody notes, Perfect for both daily wear and special occasions, it delivers a powerful, sophisticated, and contemporary scent profile favoured by both men and wome

products.name: AFNAN Supremacy Collector's Edition
products.description: Afnan Supremacy Collector’s Edition is a luxurious, fruity-woody perfume in the Eau de Parfum concentration for men, highly praised as an exceptional alternative to Creed's Aventus Absolu. It blends bright citrus and juicy pineapple with elegant white florals, resting on a rich, masculine base of ambergris and oakmoss.

products.name: Auram EDP
products.description: Launched in 2011, Ajmal Aurum is an elegant floral-fruity (EDP) for women. It opens with zesty lemon and raspberry, softening into a floral heart of gardenia and jasmine, and finishes with a warm, powdery base of vanilla, amber, and musk.

products.name: Auram Summer
products.description: Ajmal Aurum Summer is a vibrant, floral-fruity Eau de Parfum for women. It features an energetic blend of citrus and red fruits, softening into a romantic jasmine-peony heart with a warm, musky-vanilla base.

products.name: ARISTOCRAT HER EDP
products.description: Ajmal Aristocrat Her EDP is a luxurious, fruity-chypre EDP. It offers a sophisticated, warm, and feminine aroma that blends fresh berries and sweet florals with a rich, woody-amber base.

products.name: ARISTOCRAT EDP
products.description: Ajmal Aristocrat EDP for Men is a luxurious, long-lasting 2017 fragrance designed to offer sophisticated, modern elegance. It features a, crisp opening of watermelon, bergamot, and lime, followed by a floral-musky heart, and a strong, woody base of cedar, oud, and amber. The 75ml EDP provides a fresh, versatile, and confident scent suited for daily or evening wear.

products.description: Xerjoff Naxos (part of the 1861 collection) is a luxurious, unisex niche fragrance launched in 2015 that celebrates Sicilian heritage with a modern, sweet-spicy scent profile. products.name: Chrome Parfum
products.description: Azzaro Chrome Parfum (2023) is a modern, intense Citrus Aromatic fragrance for men that reinterprets the iconic 1996 original with deeper, warmer notes. It features a refreshing blend of bergamot, sage, and balsamy fir resin, evoking a sunny Mediterranean escape with a long-lasting, sophisticated, and woody finish.

products.name: Pour Homme EDT
products.description: Azzaro Pour Homme Eau de Toilette (EDT) is a classic aromatic fougere fragrance for men launched in 1978, known for its timeless, masculine, and sophisticated scent. It features a woody-herbal blend with key notes of lavender, anise, lemon, and vetiver

products.name: Wanted by night EDP
products.description: Azzaro Wanted by Night EDP is a bold, woody-spicy fragrance designed for men, featuring a "sensual evening" blend of warm cinnamon, red cedar, tobacco, and citrus. This long-lasting, magnetic scent is ideal for night-time wear. It is most commonly available in a 100ml (3.4 fl oz) spray bottle.

products.name: Forever Wanted Elixir Parfum
products.description: Azzaro Forever Wanted Elixir Parfum (2025) is an intense, woody-fruity-leathery scent for men, designed for evening, confidence, and high impact. It features a, bold, long-lasting blend of raspberry extract, cardamom heart, and a warm leather accord. This addictive, seductive scent comes in a striking gold-toned bottle, promising a powerful 12-hour scent trail.

products.name: Bentley Intense Pour Homme EDP
products.description: Bentley for Men Intense Eau de Parfum (2013) is a highly-rated, affordable woody-spicy fragrance designed by Nathalie Lorson. It is characterized by a bold, boozy, and smoky scent profile, featuring prominent notes of rum, cinnamon, leather, and incense. Known for its excellent longevity and strong projection, this scent is ideal for fall/winter and evening wear.

products.name: Obsession EDT For Men
products.description: Calvin Klein Obsession for (EDT) is a iconic 1986 "powerhouse" fragrance known for being warm, spicy, and intensely masculine. Description Fragrance Family: Oriental Woody Scent Profile: Opens with fresh bergamot, mandarin, and cinnamon, leading to a heart of lavender, nutmeg, and myrrh, with a long-lasting base of vanilla, amber, and sandalwood. Best For: Evenings and colder winter months. Characteristics: Sensual, bold, and long-lasting (4-8 hours) depending on the skin type.

products.name: Bentley Absolute Pour Homme EDP
products.description: Bentley For Men Absolute Eau de Parfum is a, "dark, luxurious, and powerfully masculine" woody-oriental fragrance launched in 2014. It is widely recognized as a "dry, ultra-woody" and smoky scent designed for confident, mature men.

products.name: Burberry London EDP Pour Femme
products.description: Burberry London EDP for Women (2006) is a sophisticated and classic floral-fresh scent designed for the modern woman, capturing the essence of London style. It features a heart of white florals—jasmine, tiare flower, and peony—balanced by rose, honeysuckle, and clementine, with a warm, velvety base of sandalwood, musk, and patchouli.

products.name: Burberry London EDT
products.description: Burberry London for Men EDT (2006) is a sophisticated, warm, and comforting Oriental Spicy fragrance that embodies a classic British gentleman's aesthetic. Often described as "Christmas in a bottle," it features key notes of cinnamon, lavender, leather, and tobacco leaf, making it an ideal, cozy scent for autumn and winter.

products.name: CK Be EDT
products.description: Calvin Klein CK Be EDT is a iconic, Woody Floral Musk unisex fragrance launched in 1996, designed to represent individuality and freedom with its "be-yourself" theme. It offers a fresh, clean scent blending lavender, mint, and white musk, making it an ideal casual, everyday scent for both men and women.

products.name: CK One Gold Unisex EDT
products.description: CK One Gold by Calvin Klein is a bold, woody-fruity unisex eau de toilette launched in 2016 as a limited edition. It is described as a summer fragrance with a fresh, juicy woody character designed for all genders. The scent features notes of fig, bergamot, neroli, and patchouli, designed for versatile, daily wear.

products.name: CK All EDT Unisex
products.description: CK All by Calvin Klein (2017) is a fresh, citrus-woody unisex Eau de Toilette designed for modern, effortless wear. It reinterprets the iconic CK One with a brighter, warmer, and more inclusive approach, featuring notes of citrus, florals, and warm amber. It is a versatile, light scent perfect for casual, daily use.

products.name: Good Girl Gold Fantasy EDP
products.description: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Gold Fantasy EDP (2022) is a luxurious, limited-edition amber floral fragrance for women, housed in a shimmering gold stiletto bottle. It features a seductive blend of almond and coffee (top notes), jasmine sambac and tuberose (heart), with cocoa and tonka bean (base), creating a warm, sweet, and confident scent.

products.name: CK One EDT
products.description: CK One by Calvin Klein (1994) is an iconic, groundbreaking unisex fragrance known for its clean, fresh, and citrusy profile. It features a light blend of bergamot, lemon, green tea, and musk, creating a versatile, intimate scent designed to be shared. It is perfect for daily wear and refreshing, casual elegance.

products.name: Bad Boy EDT For Men
products.description: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy (2019) is a bold, Oriental Spicy fragrance for men designed to embody modern masculinity’s duality—strong yet sensitive. It features a distinctive blend of black and white pepper with green bergamot, creamy cocoa, and tonka bean, creating a warm, sensual, and versatile scent with moderate to long-lasting performance. The fragrance is famously housed in a lightning bolt bottle.

products.name: Bad Boy Le Parfum EDP
products.description: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Le Parfum (2021) is a bold, energetic, and enigmatic leather-aromatic fragrance for men. It redefines modern masculinity with an edgy, "dirty green" opening of grapefruit and cannabis, settling into a warm, sensual drydown of leather and vetiver. The scent is described as a daring, long-lasting scent, perfectly suited for evenings and winter.

products.name: 212 VIP Women EDP
products.description: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Women EDP 80ml is a glamorous and energetic Oriental-Vanilla fragrance designed for the modern, confident "it girl." It opens with vibrant notes of rum and passion fruit, settles into a soft gardenia heart, and finishes with a creamy, seductive blend of vanilla and musk, making it ideal for evening wear and special occasions

products.name: Chrome EDP
products.description: Azzaro Chrome Eau de Parfum (EDP) is a modern, intense citrus-woody fragrance inspired by the Mediterranean. It offers a fresh, "shower gel" opening of bergamot and mandarin, balanced by aromatic lavender/sage, and dries down to a comforting woody, resinous base. Known for its versatility and lasting freshness, it is a refined take on the iconic original.

products.name: Chrome EDT
products.description: Azzaro Chrome Eau de Toilette (1996) is a classic, crisp citrus-aquatic fragrance for men, designed to evoke the freshness of a Mediterranean getaway. It features a clean blend of bergamot, neroli, and woody tea notes, offering a refreshing and modern scent suitable for daily wear.

products.name: The Most Wanted EDP Intense
products.description: Azzaro The Most Wanted Eau de Parfum Intense is an intense, addictive masculine fragrance with a Fougere Ambery woody scent profile. It is designed for the modern, daring man and features prominent notes of cardamom, toffee/caramel, and amber wood, making it ideal for evenings and colder seasons.

products.name: Safari Extreme 75ml
products.description: Safari Extreme by Abdul Samad Al Qurashi Originally released in 2014 is a luxurious amber and floral-leather fragrance for men. It features a bold blend of fresh citrus, delicate florals (rose, jasmine, iris), and warm woods, balanced with a smooth base of suede, oud, and vanilla.

categories.name: Niche Fragrances
categories.description: A niche fragrance is a perfume created by a specialized house whose primary, dedicated business is perfumery. Unlike mainstream designer brands that cater to mass appeal, niche brands prioritize artistic freedom, artisanal craftsmanship, and the use of premium, rare raw materials.

categories.name: Middle Eastern Fragrances
categories.description: Middle Eastern fragrances are rich, concentrated scents deeply rooted in Arabian heritage, famed for their deep, intense, and long-lasting profiles. They largely bypass alcohol-based dilution in favor of high-quality essential oils, often utilizing bold, luxurious ingredients like oud, amber, saffron, and musk. Middle Eastern perfumery differs from typical Western blends through several key characteristics such as signature notes, bakhoor & concentrated attars & the art of layering.

categories.name: Designer Fragrances
categories.description: A designer fragrance is a perfume or cologne created by a brand whose primary business is fashion, luxury goods, or lifestyle. These scents act as accessible extensions of the brand's identity, allowing everyday consumers to wear an iconic piece of luxury fashion.
